component.name: FXSound for Linux
component.summary: Audio enhancer with 10-band EQ and effects

description.p: A free, open-source audio enhancer for Linux with a 10-band equalizer, effects, presets, and real-time audio visualization.

ul.li: 5 Audio Effects: Fidelity, Ambiance, Dynamic Boost, 3D Surround, HyperBass

description.p: Fix the app aborting with EGL_BAD_PARAMETER (blank window) on machines with no usable GPU acceleration, such as VirtualBox/VMware VMs. WebKitGTK creates a shared EGL display at startup regardless of compositing mode, so the app now defaults to Mesa software rendering (LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1) so that display always initializes — completing the 1.1.1/1.1.2 rendering fixes.

Fix a blank window (AppImage) or a "Not Responding" window (deb/rpm) on newer Mesa/Wayland systems such as Fedora + GNOME. WebKitGTK accelerated compositing is now disabled so the webview no longer aborts creating an EGL display — completing the 1.1.1 rendering fix.
Fix a black, unresponsive window on some Linux systems (Fedora, NVIDIA, certain Mesa/Wayland and VM setups) caused by a WebKitGTK EGL/DMABUF renderer failure.
Implemented the Ambiance (stereo reverb) and 3D Surround (stereo widening) effects — previously non-functional sliders now shape the audio.
Fix visualizer music sync, optimize FFT bin mapping, and update screenshots.
Authentic FXSound dark theme and UI overhaul.
